page.layout: One block of running text in one column, filling the page; below it a catchword line "atque" at the right and the signature "A 4" at the centre-left foot. Page number 7 printed at the top right.

main_text.p: Sed omnium profecto est grauissima inundatio illa, qua non campi, non prata, non vici urbesque, non regiones eluuntur atque euertuntur, sed homines ipsi animaque ipsorum: quibus alioquin Dei gratia salutis, & sermo lucis esse solet. Est enim haec peccati in mentes humanas inundatio multo periculosior quam illa sit; tum quia anima corpus, & res animae res istas corporis omnibus modis antecellunt; tum vero quia facilius peruadit incautum genus nostrum, & tamquam venenum inhaerens animis cum natura ipsa a maioribus in posteros infunditur, eoque minus a nobis cernitur. Qui imbrem irruentem, qui vndas aestuantes atque
main_text.notes: Top of page shows the printed page number 7 at upper right. Some words in the lower half are faint due to show-through and may be imperfect; "Sed omnium" and "grauissima" are read from the scan with confidence; "vici" and "vndas" are as printed. The running head is absent.
